question: On Passage — Removing Barriers to Work for Disabled Americans Act (H R 8884)
bill_title: Removing Barriers to Work for Disabled Americans Act
plain_language: This bill restarts Social Security disability demonstration projects through 2031 and says a participant's total income cannot be reduced. A Yea passes it. A Nay votes no.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Clergy Act (H R 227)
plain_language: This bill establishes a two-year window for certain members of the clergy and Christian Science practitioners to revoke their exemption from Social Security and Medicare taxes on ministerial earnings. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.
